output.question: What is the current population and annual growth rate of Kinshasa?

sources.title: Kinshasa, Republic of Congo Metro Area Population (1950-2026)

output.findings:
As of 2026, the estimated metro area population of Kinshasa is 18,553,000. This reflects a continued rapid urbanization trend for the city.

The annual growth rate for Kinshasa has remained consistently high in recent years, recorded at approximately 4.36% for 2026. This follows an annual growth rate of 4.38% in 2025 and 4.39% in 2024.
